notes.title: Fixed Footage Issue
notes.content:
During the new build of Shadows Unveiled, the community noticed a serious issue that was preventing players from progressing in the story. We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. As soon as we received the feedback, we worked hard to resolve the issue and post the new build as quickly as possible.

Once again, we greatly appreciate all the support. Shadows Unveiled is an indie project in development that is being made with a lot of care and dedication by our team.

We are open to any suggestions and criticism.
